narrative: A character named Darakshan visualizes the full landscape of musical consonance by scoring every interval ratio by simplicity and arranging them on a circle, only to discover the resulting shape is the Mandelbrot set — same bulb positions as Farey fractions, same size hierarchy as consonance rankings — because both are maps of stability under iteration. The chapter argues this convergence is structural, not coincidental: wherever you draw the boundary between order and complexity, the same shape appears, and it closes with an open question about whether neural network weight-space shares this boundary.
